payload.title: The Detrended Stack
payload.description: This notebook aims to reproduce the detrended stack and synthetic stack from a research paper. It requires pre-existing pickle files containing preprocessed data, which should be generated by running other notebooks in the 'Loading Data' folder. The notebook utilizes various Python libraries to load, process, and visualize climate data, focusing on sorting data by latitude and plotting ensemble envelopes.
